source_caption:
🎬 The Kid Who Would Be King (2019)

The Kid Who Would Be King follows Alex Elliot, an ordinary 12-year-old British schoolboy whose life changes when he discovers the legendary sword Excalibur hidden at a construction site. After pulling the sword from the stone, Alex learns that he has been chosen to face an ancient evil threatening the modern world. With the help of his best friend Bedders, two former school bullies, and the legendary wizard Merlin, Alex must bring together an unlikely group of young heroes to stop the powerful sorceress Morgana from unleashing darkness upon Britain. As they embark on an extraordinary adventure filled with magic, dangerous creatures, and epic battles, Alex discovers the true meaning of courage, friendship, loyalty, and leadership. The film delivers an entertaining modern twist on the legend of King Arthur.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Adventure • Action • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h • PG

🎥 Director: Joe Cornish

✍️ Writer: Joe Cornish

📺 Where to Watch: Check Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Kid Who Would Be King is a 2019 urban fantasy action-adventure film written and directed by Joe Cornish. A British/American venture, the film stars Louis Ashbourne Serkis, Tom Taylor, Dean Chaumoo, Rhianna Doris, Angus Imrie, Rebecca Ferguson, and Patrick Stewart. The plot follows a young boy who finds King Arthur's legendary sword Excalibur and must use it to stop an ancient enchantress from enslaving the world with help from his classmates (and former bullies) from school. It was distributed and created by 20th Century Fox in association with Working Title Films.
